svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.53k stars in total, about 1.93k a year earlier. jactionlint 359, mr boxington 791, aube 2078, fnox 2421, hk 1356, pitchfork 723, usage 1084, +5 more 722.
